set.acceptance: A test resumes an interrupted run on an accepted change set, an interrupted plan run on a landed change set, and an interrupted non-plan run on a landed change set whose journal reached land, and leaves an interrupted non-plan run on a landed change set that never reached land and runs on rejected, withdrawn, proposed and draft change sets unresumed
set.statement: The daemon resumes an interrupted run only while its change set is accepted, except two runs on a landed change set: a plan-workflow run, which it resumes as in flight (daemon-resumes-landed-plan-run), and a non-plan run whose journal reached its land step (daemon-resumes-landed-past-land)

The daemon resumes an interrupted run whose change set is accepted, or whose change set has landed when it is a plan-workflow run (daemon-resumes-landed-plan-run) or a non-plan run whose journal reached its land step (daemon-resumes-landed-past-land), once, as a detached rhiza run resume --foreground <run> process outside Rex (daemon-headless-run-drivers), and journals that resume in the run's journal; it leaves alone every other interrupted run whose change set is not accepted, a run interrupted again after that resume, which the inbox lists as a run the daemon gave up on, and every failed run, which the inbox lists as failed.

set.acceptance: A test with an interrupted build run on a landed change set whose journal never reached land lists it in rhiza inbox with the state and the abandon command, and the daemon does not resume it; an interrupted plan run on a landed change set and an interrupted non-plan run on a landed change set whose journal reached land are not listed as skipped
set.statement: An interrupted run on a change set no longer accepted waits in the inbox, naming the change set's state and rhiza run abandon as the next step, except two runs on a landed change set, which the daemon resumes: a plan-workflow run, which counts as in flight (inbox-landed-plan-run-in-flight), and a non-plan run whose journal reached its land step (inbox-omits-resumable-landed-run)

set.acceptance: A testscript with fixture journals and change sets: a failed run and a gave-up run each on a landed, a withdrawn, a rejected and a superseded change set, and one of each on an accepted change set, lists exactly the accepted-change-set items in text and --json; a failed and a gave-up plan run on a landed change set stay listed, and so do a failed and a gave-up non-plan run on a landed change set whose journal reached land; a run on a change set the log does not know stays listed; a question and a sign-off on a landed change set stay listed
set.statement: rhiza inbox leaves out a failed run or a run the daemon gave up on whose change set has landed, been withdrawn, rejected or superseded, so every item it lists names a next command that can succeed on its change set; two runs on a landed change set are not left out: a plan-workflow run, since rhiza run resume works on it (inbox-landed-plan-run-in-flight), and a non-plan run whose journal reached its land step (inbox-omits-resumable-landed-run); questions and sign-offs stay listed
